# CLI

`deweyou-cli` wires skills, rules, and design contracts from this hub into other local repositories, and provides the manual DDev runtime.

DDev repositories install only the `ddev` entry skill by default. Module skills live at `~/.deweyou/agents/assets/skills/<skill>/SKILL.md` and are loaded by DDev when needed.

```bash
npm install -g deweyou-cli
deweyou-cli agent update
deweyou-cli agent init --skills ddev --rules ddev-local-state,verification-evidence,loop-boundaries --mode link --yes
deweyou-cli dev install
deweyou-cli dev doctor
```

Read the package docs in [cli/README.md](https://github.com/deweyou/agents/blob/main/cli/README.md) and the [DDev operations manual](/ddev/operations).
